Survey inputs

MD / Inc / Azi

Inclination dan azimuth adalah input pengukuran. Minimum Curvature menghitung posisi antarstasiun.

Titik pertama memakai koordinat tie-in. Azimuth searah jarum jam dari north referensi yang sama untuk semua stasiun. Perubahan unit mengonversi MD dan tie-in.

Well path

Calculated stations

+N north, +E east, +TVD downward. DLS is interval-average curvature, not a continuous bending measurement.

BHA hydraulics & mud pulse telemetry

Engineering study: smooth, circular internal flow; equivalent restriction losses. Telemetry attenuation coefficients are hypothetical and require field calibration.

Flow & fluid

Drill string geometry

Bit & pulser

Transmission assumptions

Gas fraction is local volume % at the selected absolute pressure. Used only in the acoustic study, not in the single-phase hydraulics.

Pressure loss budget

Open pulser state

Partial internal-system loss. Excludes surface equipment, annulus, motor, tool joints and other tools. This is not total standpipe pressure or ECD.

At the standpipe transducer

— Received + noise — Clean signal

AC pressure component: synthetic sinusoid + deterministic pump-like noise. Frequency is not a bit rate. SNR uses clean sinusoid RMS / assumed noise RMS. No decoder or detection guarantee is modeled.

Transmission along the fluid path

Understand it. Verify it. Explain it.

METHOD NOTES
PROJECT 01

Minimum Curvature

Survey orientation didefinisikan oleh inclination I dari vertikal bawah dan azimuth A dari north. Semua trigonometri memakai radian.

cos β = cos I₁ cos I₂ + sin I₁ sin I₂ cos(A₂ − A₁)
RF = 2 tan(β/2) / β; RF → 1 saat β → 0
ΔTVD = ΔMD · (cos I₁ + cos I₂) · RF / 2
ΔN = ΔMD · (sin I₁ cos A₁ + sin I₂ cos A₂) · RF / 2
ΔE = ΔMD · (sin I₁ sin A₁ + sin I₂ sin A₂) · RF / 2
DLS = β(degrees) × reference length / ΔMD

Web menghitung β dengan atan2(norm cross product, dot product) untuk stabilitas numerik. Excel memakai ACOS dengan clamp [−1,1]. Threshold DLS adalah nilai review pengguna, bukan limit alat.

Vertical section = (N − N₀)cos Aᵥₛ + (E − E₀)sin Aᵥₛ. Closure = jarak horizontal dari tie-in. Plot 2D berskala setara; garis menghubungkan stasiun.

Belum mencakup raw accelerometer/magnetometer processing, magnetic declination, grid convergence, sag correction, uncertainty ellipse, atau anti-collision.

PROJECT 02

Pressure and signal models

Q [m³/s] = Q [L/min] / 60,000
ΔP restriction = ρ/2 · [Q/(Cᵈ A)]²
ΔP pulse = ΔP restricted − ΔP open
ΔP pipe = fᴰ (L/D) ρv²/2
Reɢ = ρ v²⁻ⁿ Dⁿ / [K 8ⁿ⁻¹ ((3n+1)/(4n))ⁿ]

Laminar: fᴰ = 64/Reɢ. Turbulent: Dodge–Metzner smooth-pipe correlation, solved for Fanning f, then fᴰ = 4f. Reɢ 2,100–4,000 uses an illustrative interpolation; transition depends on rheology and this band is a screening convention.

Power law has no yield stress and is not a full drilling-mud model. Cd absorbs contraction and recovery effects. All nozzle diameters share one Cd; pressure drop is common across parallel nozzles.

1/Kmix = (1 − g)/Kliquid + g/(γPabs)
c = √(Kmix/ρmix); travel time = L/c
Loss [dB] = (α₀ + kɡ·gas%) √f · (0.1/Deff) · L[km]
Aₛ = ΔP pulse × 10^(−Loss/20)

Acoustics: homogeneous ideal air at 50°C, γ = 1.4, uniform pressure, rigid pipe, no background-flow correction. Gas-free liquid bulk modulus is adjustable. Deff is the length-weighted harmonic mean of internal diameters.

The attenuation law is deliberately hypothetical. α₀ is at 1 Hz and 100 mm ID; kɡ is additional dB/km per percentage point of gas. Neither coefficient is supplied by a vendor. No bubble resonance, reflections, dispersion, pressure gradient, temperature gradient, or valve dynamics are resolved. The waveform amplitude uses the restriction increment as an assumed source scale.

DEMONSTRATION

A five-minute interview walkthrough

  1. Survey: load Vertical benchmark. Show TVD = MD and zero displacement/DLS.
  2. Build & hold: identify kickoff, build interval and hold. Explain why TVD is less than MD.
  3. QC: duplicate one MD and demonstrate rejection. Change azimuth from 359° to 1° and explain circular angles.
  4. Hydraulics: increase Q; show nozzle loss scales with Q² at fixed density, area and Cd. Increase nozzle area; pressure loss falls.
  5. Telemetry: change length, gas, frequency and noise individually. Explain which trend comes from physics and which comes from chosen attenuation assumptions.

Data seluruh contoh bersifat sintetis. Sampaikan proyek sebagai studi mandiri yang telah Anda pelajari dan demonstrasikan; jangan menyebutnya validasi lapangan.

SPEAKING POINTS · ENGLISH

Explain your engineering judgment

“What did you build?”

“I built an independent survey calculator using the Minimum Curvature Method and a hydraulics and telemetry sensitivity model. I focused on unit consistency, input validation, and transparent assumptions.”

“How do you verify the survey?”

“I compare vertical, constant-inclination, and circular build cases against analytical solutions. I check increasing measured depth, azimuth wraparound, the zero-dogleg limit, and unit conversion.”

“What happens when mud contains gas?”

“Gas increases mixture compressibility and can reduce acoustic velocity. Signal attenuation also depends on bubble behavior, pressure and frequency. My simplified acoustic and attenuation models illustrate sensitivity; they require field calibration.”

“Weak signal at surface: what do you check?”

“I follow the approved troubleshooting procedure and review transducer health, connections, noise, flow stability, mud condition, surface configuration and tool status with the field team. I avoid diagnosing a downhole failure from a weak signal alone.”

“What would you improve next?”

“I would benchmark against an approved survey package, use measured rheology and pressure data, and calibrate the telemetry channel with known downhole and surface signals.”
